executive_summary.headline: The highest-trust signal is system-level assurance.
executive_summary.body: New research and NIST activity evaluate paths, skills, memory, and governance around agents rather than treating the model as the only unit of risk.

executive_summary.headline: Evaluation is becoming a lifecycle, not a launch checkpoint.
executive_summary.body: Judge calibration, long-term memory, Cyber AI guidance, and public comment frameworks all point toward continuous evidence and explicit controls.

top_picks.title: Policy algebra treats reliable capability as a path property
top_picks.author: Bhaskar Tripathi et al.
top_picks.summary: The paper defines reliable capability as completing a task through action events that remain admissible under identity, tool, data, memory, budget, approval, and audit constraints.
top_picks.enterprise_adaptation: Use this pattern in a sandbox with masked or synthetic data, least-privilege identities, version-pinned dependencies, and human approval before any consequential write. In a regulated enterprise, review data residency, model governance, secrets isolation, immutable audit logs, and rollback. Within 30 days, run one read-only workflow and measure completion, exceptions, latency, and operator review time.
